% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Shared pgfplots styles and data for the benchmark figures of the Evaluation
% chapter.  Input from preamble.tex, together with benchmarks/data/stats.tex.
%
% The tables under benchmarks/data/ are generated by benchmarks/plotdata.py
% from the campaign records; nothing in the thesis reads a campaign directly.
% No campaign number in the prose should be a typed digit: the macros of
% benchmarks/data/stats.tex carry them all, so a regenerated campaign updates
% the text.  benchmarks/benchmarks.tex is the standalone workbench in which
% these figures are developed; style and macro names are kept identical so a
% figure can move between the two unchanged --- with one exception: the
% workbench's table macro \cross is \crosstab here, out of caution around
% unicode-math symbol macros.
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

% The workbench prefixes the manuscript's colors (\definecolor{blue} would
% shadow the xcolor name that tikz and pgfplots use internally).  The
% generated tables (data/status_cross.tex) refer to the prefixed names, so
% they are aliased here rather than renamed.
\colorlet{beercol}{blue}        % ppTrans series; "both prove" outcomes
\colorlet{beerdark}{dark-blue}
\colorlet{pptcol}{orange}       % "ppTrans only" outcomes
\colorlet{pinkc}{pink}          % BEer series
\colorlet{greenc}{green}        % "BEer only" outcomes
\colorlet{beigec}{venn-dark}    % "neither" outcomes
\colorlet{creamc}{cover-cream}
% axis furniture only: rules and gridlines are not data, and a tinted rule
% reads as a series
\definecolor{grayc}{RGB}{150,150,150}

\pgfplotsset{
  % ends match the series colors: ppTrans-ahead is blue, BEer-ahead is pink
  colormap={divergent}{
    rgb255(0cm)=(0,153,173) rgb255(1cm)=(179,229,235)
    rgb255(2cm)=(255,255,255)
    rgb255(3cm)=(255,201,219) rgb255(4cm)=(255,87,146)},
}

\pgfplotsset{
  base/.style={
    width=\linewidth, height=5.4cm,
    tick align=outside, tick pos=left,
    axis line style={grayc!70},
    tick label style={font=\scriptsize},
    label style={font=\small},
    legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=none, fill=none,
                  cells={anchor=west}},
    grid=major, grid style={grayc!25, line width=.2pt},
    every axis title/.style={font=\small\bfseries, at={(0.5,1.03)},
                             anchor=south},
  },
  bars/.style={base, ybar, bar width=7pt, barlegend,
    ymin=0, ymax=100, enlarge x limits=0.12,
    ylabel={goals proved (\%)},
    xtick=data, x tick label style={font=\scriptsize},
    nodes near coords style={font=\tiny, rotate=90, anchor=west,
                             /pgf/number format/fixed,
                             /pgf/number format/fixed zerofill,
                             /pgf/number format/precision=1},
  },
  beer/.style={fill=pinkc, draw=pinkc!70!black, line width=.3pt},
  ppt/.style={fill=beercol, draw=beerdark, line width=.3pt},
  beerline/.style={pinkc, line width=1.1pt, mark=none},
  pptline/.style={beercol, line width=1.1pt, mark=none, densely dashed},
}

% a bar legend draws two swatches per entry by default; one is enough
\pgfplotsset{barlegend/.style={legend image code/.code={%
  \draw[#1,draw=none] (0cm,-0.09cm) rectangle (0.28cm,0.09cm);}}}

% one cell of the outcome matrix (data/status_cross.tex is a list of these):
% position x, position y, fill, text color, label
\newcommand{\scell}[5]{%
  \fill[#3] (axis cs:{#1-0.5},{#2-0.5}) rectangle (axis cs:{#1+0.5},{#2+0.5});
  \node[font=\small, text=#4] at (axis cs:#1,#2) {#5};}

% string columns must not be parsed as numbers
\newcommand{\readtab}[2]{%
  \pgfplotstableread[columns/label/.style={string type},
                     columns/subject/.style={string type},
                     columns/beerstat/.style={string type},
                     columns/pptstat/.style={string type},
                     columns/cls/.style={string type},
                     columns/lunsat/.style={string type},
                     columns/lunknown/.style={string type},
                     columns/lnoscript/.style={string type},
                     columns/lkilled/.style={string type}]{#1}{#2}}

\readtab{benchmarks/data/global_stack.dat}\gstack
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_order.dat}\byorder
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_subject.dat}\bysubj
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_subject_bo.dat}\bysubjbo
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_feature.dat}\byfeat
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_feature_bo.dat}\byfeatbo
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_nodes.dat}\bynodes
\readtab{benchmarks/data/by_quant.dat}\byquant
\readtab{benchmarks/data/cross.dat}\crosstab
\pgfplotstableread[columns/pog/.style={string type},
                   columns/subject/.style={string type}]{benchmarks/data/bo_files.dat}{\bofiles}
